scope: Read-only HBA file metadata and cross-database ACL inventory before credential custody and application wiring
powerShellRuntime: Windows PowerShell 5.1 with native process, prompts and Git mocked
adversarialCases: Missing, failed, uncommitted or unsafe installation evidence
Target cluster, database and port mismatch
Dirty worktree, missing psql or cancelled target confirmation before database access
Nonzero database exit, timeout or native exception with no automatic retry
Database and HBA overflow, empty inventory and invalid metadata types
Authentication-file errors retained as findings rather than treated as valid rules
Password sentinel absent from success and failure reports
limitations: Offline tests generate SQL but do not execute it or validate the native PS7 database process
HBA current file is not proof of loaded authentication rules or the Docker client route
Cross-database ACLs are potential privileges, not observed login or data access
Collection does not provision credentials, activate LOGIN or wire an application datasource
